name: ACE-Step 1.5
tagline: Full tracks from tags (+ optional lyrics) — instrumentals or songs, up to 10 min. Also **cover** (restyle your track), **repaint** (redo a section), and with the base model **lego** (add an instrument to your track) and **complete** (arrange around your idea).
disk: turbo + LM ≈ 10 GB · base model +5 GB · 4B LM +8 GB

params.name: model
params.help: turbo = fast (8 steps). sft/base = higher quality, slower (use 32–64 steps). base is required for lego/complete/extract. Each new model downloads on first use.

params.name: task
params.help: text2music = from scratch. cover = restyle input audio. repaint = redo a time range. lego / complete / extract need the base model.

params.name: caption
params.label: Caption (style tags)
params.default: deep house, 122 bpm, warm sub bass, shuffled hats, dreamy pads, analog chords, late night club

params.name: lyrics
params.help: Use [Instrumental] for no vocals, or write lyrics with [verse] / [chorus] tags.

params.name: src_audio
params.label: Source audio (cover / repaint / lego / complete / extract)

params.name: duration
params.help: Seconds.

params.name: bpm
params.help: 0 = let the model decide.

params.name: keyscale
params.help: e.g. 'A minor', 'F# major'. Empty = auto.

params.name: track
params.help: lego / extract: which instrument. complete: comma list goes in Extra kwargs as {"tracks": [..]}.

params.name: cover_strength
params.help: cover: 1 = keep the original structure closely, 0.2 = loose style transfer.

params.name: repaint_start
params.help: repaint/lego: start second.

params.name: repaint_end
params.help: repaint/lego: end second (-1 = end).

params.name: steps
params.help: Turbo: 8. Base/SFT: 32–64.

params.name: guidance_scale
params.help: Base/SFT only. Turbo ignores it.

params.name: shift
params.help: Timestep shift. 3 recommended for turbo.

params.name: batch
params.help: Variations per run, generated in parallel.

params.name: thinking
params.help: Use the 5Hz language model to plan the song (BPM, key, structure). Better results, a bit slower.

params.name: reference_audio
params.label: Style reference
params.help: Optional: a track whose overall sound/timbre to borrow.

params.name: vocal_language
params.help: Language of the vocals (unknown = auto).

params.name: use_cot_caption
params.label: LM rewrites caption
params.help: Let the planner LM expand your caption. Turn OFF to keep your exact tags.

params.name: use_cot_metas
params.label: LM picks bpm/key
params.help: Let the planner LM choose BPM, key and time signature when you leave them empty.

params.name: lm_cfg_scale
params.help: How strictly the planner LM follows your caption.

params.name: lm_top_k
params.help: Planner LM top-k (0 = off).

params.name: lm_negative_prompt
params.help: What the planner LM should steer away from.

params.name: use_adg
params.label: Adaptive dual guidance
params.help: Base/SFT models only. Better quality, slower.

params.name: cfg_interval_start
params.help: Base/SFT: where guidance starts (fraction of the steps).

params.name: cfg_interval_end
params.help: Base/SFT: where guidance ends.

notes:
- **Instrumental:** keep lyrics as `[Instrumental]`.
- **Restyle your own track:** task `cover`, drop in your track, describe the new style, and lower *cover strength* for looser takes.
- **Fix a section:** task `repaint` with start/end seconds.
- **Add an instrument to your track:** model `acestep-v15-base`, task `lego`, pick a track, and use ~32+ steps.
- First run downloads ~10 GB into `models/ace_step/`.
